datasets.description: Yemen Near Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/yemen_near_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys and data collection to classify food insecurity conditions across Yemen using the IPC methodology. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for each month of 2020, representing near-term projections of acute food insecurity status.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity phases across geographic units in Yemen.
